title: Terrorism Act 2000, Part III (Terrorist Property)
version_kind: point in time (dct:valid) of the latest revised version
converter: convert_uk.py of the Encodings session: clml_text() of tools/fetch/fetch-source.py (legalese/commons commit 9630815a7) with the body tag made a parameter, so that secondary legislation (<Secondary>) converts as well as Acts (<Primary>)
obtained_how: One GET request with curl through a short-lived EC2 relay in London (~/.claude/state/geo-relay.sh), because legislation.gov.uk answers scripted clients in Singapore with a WAF challenge; User-Agent "L4-research-check (https://legalese.com)", at least 5 seconds after the previous request (the site's robots.txt sets Crawl-delay: 5). The relay was terminated afterwards.
text_caveat: revised text; may carry more than one extent version of a provision, and prospective provisions, which CLML marks but this text does not distinguish
scope: Part III (Terrorist Property, ss 14-23B; ss 24-31 are repealed) only
